Liverpool and Chelsea are set to lock horns at Anfield in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup, with kickoff scheduled for **8pm GMT**, according to live reporting from *Sport | The Guardian*. Both clubs have named their starting lineups for the knockout fixture, unveiling a mix of seasoned regulars and emerging prospects for the mid-week domestic cup tie.

## Confirmed Starting Lineups

The report states that the hosts have selected Giorgi Mamardashvili in goal, supported by a defensive line featuring **Araujo**, **Joe Gomez**, **Virgil van Dijk**, and **Kostas Tsimikas**. In midfield, the Merseyside outfit relies on **Ryan Gravenberch**, **Trey Nyoni**, and **James McConnell**, while the attacking trident consists of **Cody Gakpo**, **Lewis Koumas**, and **Rio Ngumoha**. 

Opposing manager selections for the Stamford Bridge side include **Mike Penders** between the posts, alongside defenders **Josh Acheampong** and **Wesley Fofana**, as detailed by the same coverage. This domestic cup encounter follows a packed schedule of autumn fixtures across English football, running concurrently with other knockout ties such as the recent [Fleetwood Town v Arsenal: Carabao Cup fourth round – live](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/fleetwood-town-v-arsenal-carabao-cup-fourth-round-live) coverage.

## Context and Stakes

Domestically, the League Cup often serves as a vital proving ground for Premier League sides juggling European commitments and domestic league campaigns, offering younger talents crucial minutes against top-tier opposition. For both Liverpool and Chelsea, advancing past this round maintains squad momentum and preserves hopes for domestic silverware before the hectic winter fixture congestion begins. 

## What to Watch

As the match gets underway under the lights at Anfield, observers will be tracking how the respective tactical setups handle the youthful inclusions in both starting XIs. Subsequent coverage from *Sport | The Guardian* will track live match developments, goals, and any potential extra-time drama as the night progresses.

Sources: [Sport | The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2026/oct/28/liverpool-v-chelsea-carabao-cup-fourth-round-live)
